title: Recording: Treat Her Gently/Lonely Old People by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

Wings worked on the Venus And Mars song ‘Treat Her Gently – Lonely Old People’ on 12 March 1975.

Paul and Linda McCartney shared the vocal booth to record harmony vocals, on their sixth wedding anniversary.

To celebrate the anniversary, the studio’s general manager Terry Stark wheeled out a trolly containing Mexican food and champagne.

During a playback of ‘Treat Her Gently – Lonely Old People’, studio engineer Alan O’Duffy began harmonising with the recordings. Paul McCartney liked what he heard, and asked O’Duffy to teach the part to Denny Laine, which was then recorded.
